This application state manages the UI state and user interactions for configuring AlertMutedPeriods.
It stores user selections for muting alerts on assets, models,
and sensors, including:
Mute duration settings
Alert scope configuration (which assets/models/sensors to mute)
Override specifications for existing muted periods
New muted period specifications
Asset graph data for visualization
The state is designed to work with the mute alert enhancement features, providing
a centralized way to manage all mute-related UI state and user interactions.
